item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json, copy, work\\n\\ncases = [\\n ({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}},'current':{'a':{'hash':'9','kind':'file'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),\\n ({'declared':['x','y'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'},'y':{'kind':'file','name':'n','timestamp':1}}},{'ignored':['y']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','name':'same','timestamp':1}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','name':'same','timestamp':2}}},{},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','meta':{'b':2,'a':1}}},'current':{'x':{'meta':{'a':1,'b':2},'kind':'file'}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n]\\nfor req, pol, expected in cases:\\n before=(copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)); got=work.evaluate(req,pol); assert got==expected,(got,expected); assert (req,pol)==before\\nprint('ok',len(cases))\"]}"}
